title: Boston Gas Company files for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Agreement with the City of Boston, Boston Public Schools.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: This pricing structure is in accordance with the Department's standard and the Department, therefore, APPROVES the company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure, pursuant to G.L. c. 25 § 5D. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 00-18)
